module: Auxiliary "two-step" controller (standing-start rev limiter). Once enabled, it arms when the vehicle is almost stopped with throttle AND brake pressed, then imposes a temporary rev limiter on the engine (engine:setTempRevLimiter) at tempRevLimiterRPM. Releasing brake or throttle disarms it. A modder enables it through toggleTwoStep/setTwoStep or via the radial menu it registers. Publishes electrics.values.twoStep (jbeam name electricsName).
usage:
local ts = controller.getController("twoStepLaunch")
ts.setParameters({isEnabled = true, launchRPM = 4500})
notes: jbeam keys read in init: engineName ("mainEngine"), electricsName ("twoStep"), rpmLimit (2000 RPM).
Internal states: deactivated -> idle -> armed. Arming with keyboard: speed <= 2 m/s, throttle >= 0.2, brake >= 0.2; otherwise (gamepad/wheel): speed <= 0.5 m/s, throttle >= 0.8, brake >= 0.8.
Without an engine, updateGFX is nop and the command functions do nothing.
init registers (only once) "Two-Step" quick menu entries (toggle, RPM +/-100) via core_quickAccess; the call assumes core_quickAccess exists in the game VM (no nil check).
M.updateGFX is nop at declaration then reassigned in init (nop is an engine global not defined in this file).

updateGFX.desc: nop at load, then internal updateGFX if an engine is found.

init.desc: Reads the jbeam keys, gets the engine, sets the rev limit and registers the quick menu entries.

reset.desc: Resets the engine's temporary limiter and sets the state back to idle if it was active.

setTwoStep.desc: Enables (idle state) or disables the two-step (resets the temporary limiter) and displays a message unless silent.

changeTwoStepRPM.desc: Adds a value to the two-step rev limit and displays a message.

setParameters.desc: Applies external parameters: isEnabled (boolean) and launchRPM (RPM).

deserialize.desc: Restores the state and RPM from the serialize table.

setState.desc: Restores activation and RPM from the getState table (silent).

updateGFX.desc: Every frame: advances the state (idle -> armed) and applies/removes the temporary limiter, publishes the electric.
